definition.name: Fixed public Java fiber assembly inputs only

steps.name: Require the sole public assembly mode before any acquisition
steps.run:
python3 - <<'PY'
import os
if (os.environ['PUBLIC_FIBER_ASSEMBLY'] != 'true'
        or os.environ['PUBLIC_FIBER_DERIVED_LLVM'] not in ('true', 'false')
        or os.environ.get('PUBLIC_FIBER_PRIVATE_SCALAR_LLVM', 'false') not in ('true', 'false')
        or (os.environ['PUBLIC_FIBER_DERIVED_LLVM'] == 'true' and os.environ.get('PUBLIC_FIBER_PRIVATE_SCALAR_LLVM', 'false') == 'true')
        or os.environ['QUALIFY_SCRATCH_REFUSALS'] != 'false'
        or os.environ['JAVA_HTTP_SPI'] != 'false'):
    raise SystemExit('only the fixed public fiber assembly mode may be selected')
if os.environ['PUBLIC_FIBER_DERIVED_LLVM'] == 'true' or os.environ.get('PUBLIC_FIBER_PRIVATE_SCALAR_LLVM', 'false') == 'true':
    if (os.environ.get('GITHUB_EVENT_NAME') != 'workflow_dispatch'
            or os.environ.get('GITHUB_REF') != 'refs/heads/feat/java-llvm-ssa-consumer-20261025'):
        raise SystemExit('derived LLVM public compiler requires its explicit feature ref')
    import time
    with open(os.environ['GITHUB_ENV'], 'a', encoding='utf-8') as output:
        output.write('LSF_JAVA_LLVM_PUBLIC_STARTED=' + str(int(time.time())) + '\n')
PY

steps.name: Install only the same pinned normal public component compiler
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
python3 -m pip install --requirement tools/requirements.lock
python3 -B -m unittest tools.tests.test_java_normal_fiber_component_inputs tools.tests.test_java_public_wineh -v
curl --fail --location --retry 3 --max-time 180 \
  https://services.gradle.org/distributions/gradle-9.1.0-bin.zip \
  -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/gradle.zip"
echo "a17ddd85a26b6a7f5ddb71ff8b05fc5104c0202c6e64782429790c933686c806  $RUNNER_TEMP/gradle.zip" | sha256sum --check
unzip -q "$RUNNER_TEMP/gradle.zip" -d "$RUNNER_TEMP"
echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/gradle-9.1.0/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
curl --fail --location --max-time 180 \
  https://github.com/WebAssembly/wasi-sdk/releases/download/wasi-sdk-29/wasi-sdk-29.0-x86_64-linux.tar.gz \
  -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/wasi-sdk.tar.gz"
echo "87d1d1a2879d139cdc624b968efad3d4a97b8078cdff95e63ac88ecafd1a0171  $RUNNER_TEMP/wasi-sdk.tar.gz" | sha256sum --check --strict
tar -xzf "$RUNNER_TEMP/wasi-sdk.tar.gz" -C "$RUNNER_TEMP"
python3 tools/install_guest_bindgen.py "$RUNNER_TEMP/java-bindgen"
echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/java-bindgen" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
